switch_source: https://github.com/WashU-Astroparticle-Lab/daq/issues/69; Presto 2.17.1 recommended_dac_config scan at 5 MHz spacing, as reported in issue and repository plotting script
policy: Reject off-grid interpolation if the closed interval between its measured neighbors touches a scan uncertainty interval [upper - step, upper]. Exact measured nodes remain available. Also reject intervals spanning the unmeasured band gap. These are conservative exclusion intervals, not exact DAC switch boundaries.
configuration_limit: Actual DAC configurations and API version were not logged per October point. Single-port automatic Mixed configuration is assumed from the source notebook. Different configurations, output ports, DAC currents, nonzero IF, or shared-tile multiport operation require separate validation.
reference_plane: Signal Hound SM200C analyzer input, original measurement cable path; no cable-loss correction
measurement: 2026-10-02; median trace-peak power within +/-100 kHz of programmed frequency; RBW/VBW 100 kHz, flat-top, average detector; 0.5 s programmed dwell. Source amplitudes and spectra matched after acquisition using fitted clock alignment; this is not hardware-synchronized calibration.
